groups.title: Level 1 · First chords
groups.note: Up to three easy shapes from A, D, E, Em and Am.

groups.title: Level 2 · Open chords
groups.note: Open chords such as G and C, up to four shapes, at a relaxed pace.

groups.title: Level 3 · More changes
groups.note: Open chords with more shapes, quicker changes or a syncopated strum.

groups.title: Level 4 · First barre (F / Bm)
groups.note: Adds a first barre-type shape: F, Bm or F#m.

groups.title: Level 5 · Barre chords
groups.note: Full barre shapes such as B, Bb, Cm or C#m.
